Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Parameters marked with  are excluded in the NT version package.

Fields.Name: Trigger SpEffect ID
Fields.Description: Set the special effect ID that will be the summoning condition

Fields.Name: NPC Param ID
Fields.Description: NpcParam of the summoned character. -1: this row spawns nothing.

Fields.Name: NPC Think Param ID
Fields.Description: NpcThinkParam (AI) of the summoned character.

Fields.Name: Active SpEffect ID
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied when buddy is actively summoned

Fields.Name: Inactive SpEffect ID
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied when buddy is not actively summoned

Fields.Name: Spawn Offset: X (left/right)
Fields.Description: Sideways offset (m) of the spawn point from the summon point, in the summoner's facing frame; the final point is then placed on nearby ground.

Fields.Name: Spawn Offset: Z (forward/back)
Fields.Description: Forward/back offset (m) of the spawn point from the summon point, in the summoner's facing frame.

Fields.Name: Spawn Angle: Y
Fields.Description: Facing of the summoned character relative to the summoner's facing (degrees).

Fields.Name: Appear around Summoning Stone
Fields.Description: If any row of the summon has this set, the group appears around the area's summoning stone instead of beside the player.

Fields.Name: Disable Player Target Share
Fields.Description: Leaves the summon out of target sharing with the player.

Fields.Name: Player Follow Type
Fields.Description: Follow behaviour read by the summon's AI script.

Fields.Name: Reinforcement SpEffect: +0
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied to the summon at upgrade level +0. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Reinforcement SpEffect: +1
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied to the summon at upgrade level +1. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Reinforcement SpEffect: +2
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied to the summon at upgrade level +2. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Reinforcement SpEffect: +3
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied to the summon at upgrade level +3. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Reinforcement SpEffect: +4
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied to the summon at upgrade level +4. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Reinforcement SpEffect: +5
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied to the summon at upgrade level +5. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Reinforcement SpEffect: +6
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied to the summon at upgrade level +6. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Reinforcement SpEffect: +7
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied to the summon at upgrade level +7. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Reinforcement SpEffect: +8
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied to the summon at upgrade level +8. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Reinforcement SpEffect: +9
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied to the summon at upgrade level +9. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Reinforcement SpEffect: +10
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied to the summon at upgrade level +10. -1: none. Levels above 10 get no SpEffect.

Fields.Name: Character Init ID
Fields.Description: CharaInitParam ID this c0000 summon will use.

Fields.Name: Appear Animation ID
Fields.Description: Animation the summon plays when it appears or is moved back beside the player.

Fields.Name: Shortcut Text ID
Fields.Description: The shortcut key text for this summon.

Fields.Name: Icon ID
Fields.Description: Icon used for buddy in UI

Fields.Name: Base Leveling SpEffect ID
Fields.Description: Base SpEffect ID used for leveling with character (see HeroStatusParam).
